The '''Zeenada system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Immerian Outback/Legends|Immerian Outback]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zeenada]].<ref name="Night Moves!" />
